name: Tidewind
summary: An offshore wind farm control room with a live map of 48 spinning turbines
about: Tidewind runs a made-up offshore wind farm of 48 turbines. The array map is live: rotors spin with the wind, wakes cut output downstream, power flows down the export cable and faults blink red. It also covers turbine control, work orders, vessels and weather windows, grid curtailment requests, alarms and reports.
how: Hover a turbine on the map for its power and wind, click it to stop, start, limit or reset it
Watch output, wind direction and the alarm feed update every second
Drag a work order to On site and the turbine locks for maintenance; finish it to release it
Dispatch a crew boat when the wave forecast shows an open window
Accept a curtailment request from the grid and see every turbine share the limit
Switch the output chart between 24 hours, 7 days and 30 days
